message.title: Intel to Buy Israeli Startup Classiq in Quantum Computing Push - Bloomberg.com
message.body:

By Ian King

October 26, 2026 at 8:01 PM UTC

Save

Translate

Intel Corp. agreed to buy Israeli startup Classiq Technologies Ltd. as part of a push to capitalize on quantum computing, a still-nascent field that is seeking commercial applications.

The chipmaker didn’t disclose the price it’s paying for Classiq, whose clients include BMW AG and AT&T Inc. The announcement comes just head of Intel’s third-quarter earnings report Thursday.
